---
title: "Daylight"
---

```{r}
source("R/weather.R")
payload <- fetch_weather()
daily <- daily_frame(payload)
daily$daylight_hours <- as.numeric(difftime(daily$sunset, daily$sunrise, units = "hours"))
```

## Light for the week ahead

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(daily, aes(date, daylight_hours)) + geom_col(fill = "#fbbf24") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Hours between sunrise and sunset") + theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

The original detailed sun and seasonal analysis remains preserved in `weather_pushoverr.Rmd` while this Quarto view becomes the published, daily dashboard.
